spanish: Y los balanceará el sacerdote balanceo delante de Jehová; santidad él al sacerdote, sobre pecho del balanceo y sobre pierna de la ofrenda alzada; y después beberá el nazir vino.

findings.issue: Common noun with the article, not a proper name; "nazir" leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.
Hiphil sequential perfect is smoothed to a simple future.
One noun is rendered as "ofrenda" plus the added adjective "alzada".
עַל stays open (upon, concerning, besides); "sobre" selects the spatial sense.

notes: Other tokens match in number, person, and participants; the verbless clause adds no unmarked copula.
